fields.acceptance: A web package test renders / over a fixture repo with daemon status and health data and asserts the paused state, the slots and each health part with its state.
fields.statement: The Overview page at / shows the daemon: running or paused, run slots used of its limit, and each health part with its ok, warn or bad state.

fields.acceptance: A web package test renders / over fixture run journals and asserts each live run's title, workflow, current step and link, and that finished runs are not listed.
fields.statement: The Overview page lists the live runs, each with its change set's title, workflow and current step, linking to its run page.

fields.acceptance: A web package test renders / over a fixture inbox with a question, a sign-off and a failed run and asserts all three, oldest first, and an empty state when the inbox is empty.
fields.statement: The Overview page lists what waits on the owner, as rhiza inbox does (questions, sign-offs, failed or given-up runs, stalled sessions), oldest first, marked in the warning accent.

fields.acceptance: A web package test renders / over a fixture with a milestone of change sets in several states and asserts the counts by state and the roadmap link.
fields.statement: The Overview page shows each open milestone's progress: its change sets counted by state, linking to the roadmap.

fields.acceptance: A web package test asserts each Overview section declares its event names and that each section's fragment URL renders that section alone.
fields.statement: Each Overview section is a live section that re-renders on its events: the runs section on run journal moves, the inbox on inbox changes, the milestone section on change set moves, the daemon section on status changes.
